# DeepThought

> DeepThought is a done-for-you digital advertising service for small and medium businesses.
> We plan, buy, launch and manage your ads across 22 advertising products: search, social,
> streaming TV, video, display, audio, email, direct mail, local and retail media.
> Our AI recommends channels, budgets and audiences, drafts the ad creative, and writes
> plain-English reports. Our team runs the media. You approve; we run it.

Based in Gwinnett County, Georgia. Serves businesses across the United States, from single
locations to multi-location operators and franchise systems. Month to month, no long-term
contract. Costs a fraction of a typical agency retainer; exact pricing comes from a short call.

Phone: 770-299-9583
Email: support@deepthought.marketing
Website: https://deepthought.marketing/

## What DeepThought does

- Plans your media: which channels, how much budget, which audiences
- Buys and places the media on every platform we run
- Builds the ads: copy, images and video, drafted by AI and reviewed by our team
- Launches and manages campaigns: bids, budgets, pacing and creative refreshes
- Reports results in plain English on the schedule you choose
- Assigns a named marketing expert to every account

## Advertising products we run (22)

- Search: Google Search ads, Microsoft (Bing) Ads, Google Local Services Ads, Performance Max and Shopping
- Social: Facebook and Instagram, LinkedIn, Nextdoor, TikTok
- Video and streaming TV: YouTube, connected TV (CTV/OTT), online video pre-roll
- Display: programmatic display, native ads, retargeting, geofencing
- Audio: streaming audio, podcast ads
- Email and direct mail: targeted email, email match, postal direct mail
- Local: Yelp ads
- Retail media: Amazon ads

## Who it's for

Local and regional businesses that want professional advertising without hiring an agency
or an in-house team: home services, retail, restaurants, healthcare, dental, auto, fitness,
real estate, and multi-location brands.

## Common questions

**Is DeepThought software I run myself?** No. DeepThought runs your advertising for you. Our
AI handles planning, drafting and reporting; our team buys the media, launches the campaigns
and manages them. You approve direction and get plain-English reports.

**Is it an agency?** It does the work an agency does, at a fraction of the cost, because AI
handles the planning, drafting and reporting that agencies bill hours for.

**How fast can campaigns go live?** As soon as possible once approvals are in place. There is
no weeks-long production queue.

**How does pricing work?** Month to month, no long-term contract. Your exact price comes from
a short call.

**Can I start with one channel?** Yes. Start with one product, such as Google Search, and add
channels when the results justify it.

**Where is DeepThought based?** Gwinnett County, Georgia. We serve businesses nationwide.
